name: Required Input Files
description: Essential input files needed for every Mutect2 run. The tumor BAM and reference genome are mandatory. Companion index files (.bai, .fai, .dict) will be auto-generated by the wrapper if absent.

name: Tumor-Normal & Supporting Files
description: Matched normal BAM for tumor-normal somatic calling (omit for tumor-only mode), plus supporting resource files: germline allele frequency VCF, panel of normals, and genomic intervals. Companion index files (.bai, .tbi) will be auto-generated if absent.

name: Variant Calling Options
description: Core options controlling the variant calling workflow, including post-call filtering, orientation bias correction, mitochondrial mode, and PCR indel modeling.

name: Sensitivity & Filtering Thresholds
description: Advanced LOD score thresholds and base quality settings that control variant sensitivity and specificity. Modify these to tune the balance between true positives and false positives.

name: Performance & Resources
description: Settings for JVM memory allocation and CPU threading to optimize runtime performance. Adjust based on your compute environment and data size.
